about.title: About

recruit.title: Recruitment
recruit.description: We need some game-loving computer experts and UI designers. To ensure the continuous development of the map tool, optimize user experience, and ensure code quality after open-sourcing during public beta, we need you to join us.
recruit.point1: Familiar with game data analysis to help us better understand map-related data
recruit.point2: Familiar with backend development, server operations, CI/CD
recruit.point3: Familiar with frontend development frameworks and tools, especially React framework and OpenLayers
